text:
(5) The power of the court under subsection (4) includes power to order the object to be
destroyed or to be given to the prosecutor or to be placed in his custody for such period
as the court may specify.

(6) If—
(a) the court proposes to make an order under subsection (4), and
(b) the person found guilty, or any other person claiming to have an interest in
the object, applies to be heard by the court,
the court must not make the order unless the applicant has been given an opportunity
to be heard.
Criminal Procedure and Investigations Act 1996 (c. 25)
